_readme: SC id reservations. Read by lib/sc-reservations.ts and enforced by lib/create-sc.ts.
Declare your block HERE, on main, before you consume any id — including a renumber
during a repair, a hand-written fixture id, or a block chosen by eyeballing headroom.
A renumber is an allocation. See .claude/rules/parallel-sessions.md and issue #725.
Shape: every entry needs owner (branch name or issue ref), from and to (inclusive,
positive integers below the 9000 fixture floor). note is optional. Blocks must not
overlap — the reader refuses the whole store if two do, because a store that hands
one id to two owners is worse than no store at all.
The `reservations` key is the control string: an object without it is UNREADABLE,
not empty, and the allocator refuses rather than returning a number. Delete your
entry when your branch merges; a block nobody prunes is headroom nobody can use.
